name: media-editor
description: Edits images, video and audio on your own computer, inside the folders you choose.
long_description: It resizes, converts, crops and compresses images. It trims, converts, subtitles, overlays, joins, repairs and packages video and audio for streaming. ffmpeg and ffprobe ship inside the extension, so nothing else needs installing. It only opens files inside the folders chosen in its settings and never changes an original, saving every result in a new numbered folder inside the output folder. No file, name or metadata leaves the computer.

tools.name: media_health
tools.description: Reports the server version, where ffmpeg and ffprobe were found, which encoders and filters they offer, the image engine versions, and the folders and limits in effect.

tools.name: image_resize
tools.description: Resizes one image to a width, a height, or both.

tools.name: image_convert
tools.description: Converts one image to jpeg, png, webp, or avif.

tools.name: image_crop
tools.description: Crops one rectangular region from an image.

tools.name: image_compress
tools.description: Compresses one jpeg, png, webp, or avif image in its own format.

tools.name: image_rotate
tools.description: Rotates one image by an angle in degrees.

tools.name: image_flip
tools.description: Mirrors one image horizontally, vertically, or both ways.

tools.name: image_probe
tools.description: Reads the format, pixel size, channels, bit depth, colour space, density, alpha and byte size of one image.

tools.name: image_batch_resize
tools.description: Resizes one image into each listed size.

tools.name: audio_extract
tools.description: Extracts the audio track from a video or audio file into a file of its own.

tools.name: video_trim
tools.description: Cuts one video to the span between two times.

tools.name: audio_convert_properties
tools.description: Changes an audio file's container and can set its bitrate, sample rate, and channel count.

tools.name: video_convert_properties
tools.description: Changes a video's container and can set its resolution, codecs, bitrates, frame rate, and audio properties.

tools.name: video_set_aspect_ratio
tools.description: Fits one video to a target aspect ratio by padding it or by cropping it.

tools.name: audio_convert
tools.description: Changes the container of one audio file.

tools.name: audio_set_bitrate
tools.description: Re-encodes one audio file at a target bitrate.

tools.name: audio_set_sample_rate
tools.description: Re-encodes one audio file at a target sample rate.

tools.name: audio_set_channels
tools.description: Re-encodes one audio file at a target channel count.

tools.name: video_convert
tools.description: Changes the container of one video.

tools.name: video_set_resolution
tools.description: Scales one video to a target picture size.

tools.name: video_set_codec
tools.description: Re-encodes the picture of one video as libx264, libx265, or libvpx-vp9.

tools.name: video_set_bitrate
tools.description: Re-encodes the picture of one video at a target bitrate.

tools.name: video_set_frame_rate
tools.description: Re-encodes the picture of one video at a target frame rate.

tools.name: video_set_audio_codec
tools.description: Re-encodes the audio track of one video as aac, libmp3lame, or libopus, copying the picture when it can.

tools.name: video_set_audio_bitrate
tools.description: Re-encodes the audio track of one video at a target bitrate, copying the picture when it can.

tools.name: video_set_audio_sample_rate
tools.description: Re-encodes the audio track of one video at a target sample rate in hertz, copying the picture when it can.

tools.name: video_set_audio_channels
tools.description: Re-encodes the audio track of one video at a target channel count, copying the picture when it can.

tools.name: video_add_subtitles
tools.description: Burns one SubRip subtitle file into one video, using the subtitles filter and the font folder that ships with the server.

tools.name: video_add_text_overlay
tools.description: Draws one or more timed text overlays over a video, one drawtext filter per element.

tools.name: video_add_image_overlay
tools.description: Places one scaled image over a video for a time span, at a chosen position and with an optional opacity.

tools.name: video_concat
tools.description: Joins two or more videos into one file, in the order they are given.

tools.name: video_set_speed
tools.description: Changes how fast a video plays, speeding the picture up or slowing it down while the audio tempo follows the same factor.

tools.name: media_remove_silence
tools.description: Finds silent stretches in an audio or video file and keeps the loud parts, so the result plays back to back.

tools.name: video_add_b_roll
tools.description: Overlays one or more clips onto a main video as timed overlays, each at its own position and shown length, with optional fades.

tools.name: video_add_fade
tools.description: Adds one fade from black at the start or one fade to black at the end of a video.

tools.name: media_probe
tools.description: Reads container and stream metadata from one image, audio or video file with ffprobe: format name, duration, size and bit rate, plus the codec, pixel size, frame rate, sample rate and channel layout of every stream.

tools.name: media_repair
tools.description: Diagnoses a damaged or partly readable video or audio file with ffprobe, then rewrites it with a matching ffmpeg pass: remux copies the streams into a fresh container, which repairs a missing or broken index or timestamp table; reencode rebuilds the streams as H.264 and AAC (AAC alone for audio), which repairs damaged or cut-short streams.

tools.name: video_hls_ladder
tools.description: Encodes one video into an HLS ladder for streaming: one master playlist, one playlist per selected rung (1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p) and H.264 segments beside every playlist, all inside one new numbered folder.

tools.name: media_setup_ffmpeg
tools.description: Finds ffmpeg and ffprobe, and downloads a pinned build of either one that is missing after the user consents.

allowed_directories.title: Folders Media Editor may open
allowed_directories.description: Media Editor opens files only inside these folders. Add every folder that holds media you want to edit.

output_directory.title: Output folder
output_directory.description: Edited files are saved here, each run in a new numbered folder. Leave it empty to use the first folder above. To edit a result again, the output folder must also be one of the folders above.
